versions.changelog:
- Updated license from MIT to MIT-0.
- Clarified handling and permissions of the `~/.ephemo_credentials` file; users are now informed that this file exists, stores their API key, and should be kept out of source control.
- Metadata updated to include `config_paths` for persisted credential file.
- Minor language tweaks in documentation around credential storage and user instructions.
Initial release of the Ephemo Agentic Hosting Skill. Enables autonomous deployment, permanent site claiming, and full lifecycle management on the Edge.
